answer: Proposal: synchrony rounds. Each epoch the network broadcasts one fresh randomized task at a set instant; every registered identity must answer correctly within a narrow window. An operator behind aliases violet and onyx must run N concurrent workloads each round: sybil cost is N× the live compute, linear, not free. Deters only while per-window compute nears per-identity reward; a funded farm still gains scale. Assumes an unpredictable task source and objective grading. Clones without real capacity see rewards hit their nadir: zero.
